overview_description.description:
Nearpay is a fintech startup based in Saudi Arabia, on a mission to make payments easy, secure, and accessible for every merchant.
Our focus is simple: we build innovative payment infrastructure solutions that cater to banks, payment providers, and SaaS startups. 
With a blend of expertise and enthusiasm, we're shaping the future of payments one transaction at a time.

identifier.value: Muhammad Al-Aiban Co-Founder & Chief Executive Officer @ Nearpay

competitors_list.target_short_description: Adyen is the financial technology platform of choice that helps businesses achieve their ambitions faster.
Paymob is a digital payments enabler for emerging markets, helping small and large enterprises accept payments online and in-store.
Stripe is a financial technology company that provides online payment processing and payment infrastructure for businesses.
Worldline is the platform that provides payments and transactional services.
Tap is an online payment system that enables its users to accept payments using global debit and credit cards.
PayCore is a fintech company that offers advanced complete payment and processing solutions for the banking, telecom, and payment sectors.
MagicCube is a security platform for mobile and IoT devices, delivering hardware-grade protection without the complexity and constraints.
Viva.com is a cloud-based neobank that offers card acceptance services.
Nexi is the player in Italy in providing card issuing services for credit, debit and pre-paid cards.
Alcinéo is specialized in the development of embedded software implementing smart card technologies and security.
Mada is Saudi Arabia’s national payment network connecting banks, ATMs, POS, and online platforms to process local electronic payments.
Soft Space is a tech company working in the digital payments sector.

product.name: NearPay SoftPOS
product.description: A software solution that transforms NFC-enabled smartphones and tablets into secure payment terminals for contactless card payments without additional hardware.

product.name: NearPay SDK
product.description: A software development kit that enables integration of NearPay’s payment acceptance features into merchant applications across multiple platforms and programming languages.

product.name: NearPay Tap to Pay Platform
product.description: A payment infrastructure platform that enables merchants to accept in-person NFC card payments on any device, supporting secure and compliant contactless transactions.
